sources.title: Krea2_Characters: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Krea2_Characters is a text-to-image model maintained by EllaPriest45 that functions as a backup archive of character generation models from CivitAI and Hugging Face. The model represents a collection of LoRAs (Low-Rank Adaptations) originally created by various artists and developers, preserved by the maintainer as safeguard against data loss.
